text: . Praziquantel is used in the treatment of clonorchiasis and opisthorchiasis, and has also been used in the treatment of fascioliasis (p.137) although in this latter infection bithionol or triclabendazole are preferred. Various studies have shown praziquantel to be effective in clonorchiasis1-4 and opisthorchiasis,5,6 although one study in opisthorchiasis7 showed that re-infection was common despite praziquantel therapy, particularly in those with heavy initial in- fection. A study in Thailand8 confirmed that mass treatment for opisthorchiasis with a single dose of praziquantel was beneficial, although it was suggested that ideally treatment should be given twice a year. While praziquantel is not the drug of choice for fascioliasis, there has been a report9 of successful treatment of a patient with severe infection.
